name: Bookmarks
description: Save the current map view (center, zoom, active layers, time) as a named bookmark and fly back to it later. Bookmarks are per user and per mission, optionally shared.

descriptionFull.title: Bookmarks stores named map views on the server, scoped per mission and per user. Shared bookmarks are visible to everyone in the mission. Clicking a bookmark flies the map (and globe, if active) to that view and restores the active layers and time.

author: NASA-AMMOS/MMGIS
